displayName: Sun and sky by time segment
description: The sun the island stands under, per ExpeditionState::time_segment. The four keys are the four segments the simulation has and no others; game/scripts/atmosphere/atmosphere.gd reads this table and owns no number of its own. hour_of_day refines a segment rather than replacing it: the strategic clock's hour supplies the fraction between this segment's row and the next one's, so the sun crawls instead of snapping at a segment boundary.

hourFraction.note: ExpeditionState::advance_time rolls one segment every 360 minutes, and StrategicClock counts 24 hours to the day; six hours is that same day divided the same way. The fraction is (hour_of_day mod 6) / 6.

notes: Art direction, not a design decision the brief left Open: nothing in section 20 fixes a sun angle. Retuning the island's light is editing this file and no code.
Colour is authored as a temperature and converted once, in atmosphere.gd. An authored hex beside the kelvin would be two answers to one question.
Midnight's light is the moon: high, cold and nearly out. The warmth at night comes from the point lights at held buildings, which atmosphere.transitions owns.
